Immersion data reference

Generated from output_schema.yaml

immersion_data.Rmd

Logger immersion (wet/dry) data

  • session_id

    type: string

    Unique ID of the logger deployment session during which this record was made.

  • individ_id

    type: string

    Unique ID of individual.

  • date_time

    type: datetime

    Date and time of each record in GMT.

  • conductivity

    type: integer

    Original conductivity (wet/dry) data; 0 = dry all the time.

  • std_conductivity

    type: float

    Normalized conductivity between 0 (dry all the time) and 1 (wet all the time).
